step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture describes a CI/CD pipeline for deploying applications and infrastructure. The process starts with a developer committing code to CodeCommit. This triggers CodePipeline, which orchestrates the build process in CodeBuild. CodeBuild then outputs a container image to Amazon ECR. Once the image is in ECR, CloudFormation is triggered to deploy the application and its underlying infrastructure, including Amazon ECS, IAM roles, and an Application Load Balancer (ALB) within a specified VPC. The visual diagram clearly shows the flow of services and their relationships, with additional details from the transcript for clarification.

graph.name: Etion Healthcare Analytics CI/CD Architecture
graph.categories: CI/CD, Healthcare, Analytics, Containerization, Infrastructure as Code
graph.notes: This architecture leverages AWS developer tools to create a streamlined, consistent, and governed deployment process for healthcare analytics applications, including parallel deployments to multiple customer VPCs with controlled change sets.

nodes.name: Developer
nodes.notes: An Etion developer initiating code changes and infrastructure template modifications.

nodes.name: CodeCommit Repository
nodes.notes: Stores application source code and CloudFormation infrastructure templates.

nodes.name: CodePipeline
nodes.notes: Orchestrates the entire CI/CD workflow from commit to deployment.

nodes.name: CodeBuild
nodes.notes: Builds application containers, paying only for the duration of the build.

nodes.name: Amazon ECR Registry
nodes.notes: Stores the Docker container images built by CodeBuild, ready for deployment.

nodes.name: CloudFormation
nodes.notes: Manages the deployment of both application code (via container images) and underlying infrastructure (like ALB, IAM roles) using templates. It supports a three-step process (Change Set, Approve, Execute) and parallel deployments to up to 100 VPCs.

nodes.name: Production VPC
nodes.notes: The Virtual Private Cloud environment where the application and its infrastructure are deployed.

nodes.name: Elastic Container Service
nodes.notes: Runs the containerized applications within the VPC.

nodes.name: IAM
nodes.notes: Manages roles and permissions required by the application components within the VPC.

nodes.name: Application Load Balancer
nodes.notes: Distributes incoming traffic to the ECS tasks running the application.

edges.notes: Developer commits application code or infrastructure templates to the CodeCommit repository.
CodeCommit change triggers the CodePipeline workflow.
CodePipeline orchestrates the CodeBuild stage, initiating the build process.
CodeBuild pushes the successfully built container image to Amazon ECR.
The availability of the container image in ECR triggers the CloudFormation deployment stage.
CloudFormation provisions and updates resources within the target VPC.
CloudFormation deploys and configures ECS services and task definitions.
CloudFormation creates and manages necessary IAM roles and policies.
CloudFormation provisions and configures the Application Load Balancer.
